- Provides read-only access to Outline via the OOMOL-connected `oo` CLI workflow.
- Supports retrieving collections, documents, and collection document trees.
- Enables listing collections and documents with filtering, pagination, sorting, and status controls.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`

- Operates Outline through an OOMOL-connected account using the `oo` CLI, without exposing raw API tokens.
- Supports read-only collection and document workflows for accessible Outline workspaces.
- Retrieves individual collections and documents by UUID, URL ID, or share-link context.
- Lists collections, documents, and collection document trees with filtering, pagination, and sorting options.
- Searches Outline documents by keyword with scope, recency, snippet, pagination, and sorting controls.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`

- Initial release of the `oo-outline` skill for working with Outline through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Adds read-only Outline access via the `oo` CLI, with credentials handled server-side by OOMOL.
- Supports listing accessible collections and documents with filtering, pagination, and sorting options.
- Supports retrieving individual collections and documents by UUID, URL ID, or share-link context where applicable.
